qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [G = Stay with me.]
1. I'm afraid you'll get angry with me, but I have to tell you what happened. I've broken your new iPad, and I can't afford to have it fixed. I feel terrible.
2. We all know that you had good intentions, but we all make mistakes sometimes. Just apologise sincerely, explain yourself, learn from it and move on. Beating yourself up won't help anyone.
3. The tea is in the pot, and there's plenty of fruit in the fridge. Stay in bed and take both aspirins and vitamins regularly. You should feel better soon.
4. Handling this machine is a bit risky and should be done properly, so read the instructions carefully and make sure everybody listens and wears all the protective gear that came in the package.
5. Moving out of your comfort zone will require a bit of courage and confidence. Life is sometimes scary, but playing it safe is not how you achieve great things.
items: 1 — I've broken your new iPad. I can't afford to have it fixed. I feel terrible.
2 — We all make mistakes. Just apologise, learn from it and move on.
3 — Stay in bed and take aspirins and vitamins regularly. You should feel better soon.
4 — Handling this machine is risky. Read the instructions and wear all protective gear.
5 — Moving out of your comfort zone requires courage. Playing it safe is not how you achieve great things.

What did Hailey think of the film?

"Although the online critics rated it very poorly and described it as dull, I remembered that you found it entertaining. Since we usually like similar films, I thought it would be at least action-packed. After watching it, I think I'll have to side with the critics this time."

A It was boring.
B It was amusing.
C It was dramatic.

What time will Charli start warming up at school before the try-outs?

"The try-outs for the basketball team start tomorrow at 9 o'clock. The coach said we should be there any time from 8.15 to warm up. I'll be there about a quarter of an hour before the start since I'm walking to school."

A At 8.15.
B At 8.45.
C At 9.00.

Why are Loren and Zach going on their road trip?

"I wanted to ask you if we could make a little detour on Friday and stop in Reading to see my family there. It's not that far from Oxford and our scheduled university tour doesn't start until Saturday at 1 pm. On our way back on Sunday, we could also stop at that designer outlet centre in Swindon."

A To visit Loren's family in Reading.
B To do some shopping in Swindon.
C To look around a university in Oxford.
opts: To visit Loren's family in Reading.
To do some shopping in Swindon.
To look around a university in Oxford.
